paper.title: An RNA Language Model trained on sequence alone reveals the structural logic of Internal Ribosome Entry Sites
paper.status: bioRxiv preprint; not certified by peer review

endpoint.name: Ribosomal_Loading
endpoint.meaning: average ribosomes per RNA, polysome loading proxy for translation
endpoint.normalization: Barcode counts normalized to total reads per sample and then fractional representation in unseparated lysate; polysome-weighted expectation.
endpoint.polysome_assay_post_transfection_time: not stated in inspected main text, supplementary methods, or GEO sample record; 24-hour luciferase and 6-hour DMS times are separate assays
endpoint.circRNA_origin: in vitro generated circRNA library; do not conflate with separate DNA-transfected bicistronic luciferase validation
endpoint.replicates: 2 biological x 2 technical per cell; Fig 2 n=4/cell does not mean 4 independent biological replicates
